title: 地下含水層季節儲熱
subcategoryTitle: 機械、壓縮空氣與熱儲能
summary: 含水層儲熱利用地下幾十到幾百公尺深的飽水砂層當作巨大的蓄熱體：夏天把建築排出的熱經由井注入地下，冬天抽出來供暖；冬天的冷則存到夏天直接冷卻用。地下水本身既是儲存的介質，也是輸送的流體。柏林的德國國會大廈在兩個不同深度的含水層分別儲存冷與熱。課程定量分析蓄熱量、熱半徑、井的洩降、熱羽流的漂移、直接冷卻的效率、冷熱平衡與所需的井數。
summaryEn: Aquifer thermal energy storage uses water-saturated sand tens to hundreds of metres down as a huge store: in summer heat rejected by buildings is injected through wells and in winter drawn out for heating, while winter cold is kept for direct cooling in summer. Groundwater is both storage medium and carrier fluid. The German parliament building in Berlin stores cold and heat in aquifers at two depths. The course quantifies heat stored, thermal radius, well drawdown, drift of the thermal plume, efficiency of free cooling, thermal balance and wells needed.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

v30FocusEn: Keeping summer heat for winter and winter cold for summer: thermal radius, well drawdown, groundwater drift, free cooling and thermal balance

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：地下含水層季節儲熱
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Aquifer Seasonal Thermal Energy Storage
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「顯熱蓄熱量」與「含水層的儲熱密度」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sensible heat storage" and "Storage density of an aquifer": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「顯熱蓄熱量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sensible heat storage" is correct?
options: 最簡單的蓄熱方式是讓水、岩石或土壤升溫。
蓄熱槽裡的熱量只看總量，溫度分布不重要。
地下蓄熱需要挖一個很大的水槽。
optionsEn: The simplest heat store warms water, rock or soil.
Only the total heat in a storage tank matters, not its temperature distribution.
Storing heat underground needs a very large tank dug out.
quiz.explanation: 最簡單的蓄熱方式是讓水、岩石或土壤升溫。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The simplest heat store warms water, rock or soil. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 顯熱蓄熱量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Sensible heat storage: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「顯熱蓄熱量」如何決定「地下含水層季節儲熱」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sensible heat storage” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Aquifer Seasonal Thermal Energy Storage”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 最簡單的蓄熱方式是讓水、岩石或土壤升溫。儲存的熱量等於質量、比熱與溫差的乘積；水的比熱在常見材料中最高，又便宜無毒，所以從家用熱水槽到數萬立方公尺的區域供熱蓄熱槽都用水。大型蓄熱體的表面積對體積比小，熱損比例低，甚至可以把夏天的太陽熱存到冬天使用，稱為季節性蓄熱。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The simplest heat store warms water, rock or soil. Stored heat is mass times specific heat times temperature change; water has the highest specific heat of common materials and is cheap and non-toxic, so it serves from domestic cylinders to district-heating tanks of tens of thousands of cubic metres. A large store has a small surface-to-volume ratio and low relative loss, and can even carry summer solar heat into winter as seasonal storage. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：國會大廈的系統於 1999 年啟用
steps.observationEn: Project file: The system at the parliament building started in 1999
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「蓄熱槽裡的熱量只看總量，溫度分布不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Only the total heat in a storage tank matters, not its temperature distribution." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「顯熱蓄熱量」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Sensible heat storage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Stored heat is mass times specific heat times temperature change; water has the highest specific heat of common materials and is cheap and non-toxic, so it serves from domestic cylinders to district-heating tanks of tens of thousands of cubic metres. A large store has a small surface-to-volume ratio and low relative loss, and can even carry summer solar heat into winter as seasonal storage.

knowledge.text: 誤解：蓄熱槽裡的熱量只看總量，溫度分布不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 依「顯熱蓄熱量」的模型 Q = m·c_p·ΔT / 3600，水體升溫 ΔT 所儲存的熱量最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model Q = m·c_p·ΔT / 3600 for "Sensible heat storage", which value is closest to the heat stored by warming the water volume through ΔT?
options: 465 MWh
930 MWh
optionsEn: 465 MWh
930 MWh
quiz.explanation: Q = m·c_p·ΔT / 3600；代入 Vs = 100000 m³、cpw = 4.186 kJ/(kg·K)、dTs = 8 K，得 930 MWh（水體升溫 ΔT 所儲存的熱量）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: Q = m·c_p·ΔT / 3600; with Vs = 100000 m³, cpw = 4.186 kJ/(kg·K), dTs = 8 K the result is 930 MWh (heat stored by warming the water volume through ΔT). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 顯熱蓄熱量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sensible heat storage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「顯熱蓄熱量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Sensible heat storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q = m·c_p·ΔT / 3600；代入 Vs = 100000 m³、cpw = 4.186 kJ/(kg·K)、dTs = 8 K，得 930 MWh（水體升溫 ΔT 所儲存的熱量）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 dTs 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q = m·c_p·ΔT / 3600; with Vs = 100000 m³, cpw = 4.186 kJ/(kg·K), dTs = 8 K the result is 930 MWh (heat stored by warming the water volume through ΔT). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise dTs by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：dTs 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1,023 MWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising dTs by 10% changes the result to 1,023 MWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 930 MWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 dTs 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 930 MWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in dTs with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Q = m·c_p·ΔT / 3600；代入 Vs = 100000 m³、cpw = 4.186 kJ/(kg·K)、dTs = 8 K，得 930 MWh（水體升溫 ΔT 所儲存的熱量）。
knowledge.textEn: Q = m·c_p·ΔT / 3600; with Vs = 100000 m³, cpw = 4.186 kJ/(kg·K), dTs = 8 K the result is 930 MWh (heat stored by warming the water volume through ΔT).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: dTs 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1,023 MWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising dTs by 10% changes the result to 1,023 MWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「顯熱蓄熱量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sensible heat storage"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
一度電的熱和一度電的電價值完全相同。
以蓄熱體內多層溫度感測器求平均溫度與分層情形，配合充放熱迴路的熱量表做能量平衡，計算一個週期的蓄熱效率。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A kilowatt-hour of heat is worth exactly the same as a kilowatt-hour of electricity.

Use multi-level temperature sensors in the store for mean temperature and stratification, and balance energy with heat meters on the charge and discharge circuits to compute storage efficiency over a cycle.
quiz.explanation: 以蓄熱體內多層溫度感測器求平均溫度與分層情形，配合充放熱迴路的熱量表做能量平衡，計算一個週期的蓄熱效率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use multi-level temperature sensors in the store for mean temperature and stratification, and balance energy with heat meters on the charge and discharge circuits to compute storage efficiency over a cycle. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 顯熱蓄熱量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sensible heat storage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「顯熱蓄熱量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sensible heat storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以蓄熱體內多層溫度感測器求平均溫度與分層情形，配合充放熱迴路的熱量表做能量平衡，計算一個週期的蓄熱效率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use multi-level temperature sensors in the store for mean temperature and stratification, and balance energy with heat meters on the charge and discharge circuits to compute storage efficiency over a cycle. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：蓄熱系統要以「可用溫度以上的熱量」而非總熱量評估性能，並把分層品質列入驗收量測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Assess a heat store by heat above the useful temperature rather than total heat, and include stratification quality in acceptance measurement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：進水擴散器設計不良使冷熱水混合、分層被破壞，雖然總熱量沒有少，可用的高溫熱卻減少，熱泵或鍋爐被迫提早啟動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor inlet diffusers mix hot and cold water and destroy stratification; total heat is unchanged but useful high-temperature heat is reduced and the heat pump or boiler starts early. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以蓄熱體內多層溫度感測器求平均溫度與分層情形，配合充放熱迴路的熱量表做能量平衡，計算一個週期的蓄熱效率。
knowledge.textEn: Use multi-level temperature sensors in the store for mean temperature and stratification, and balance energy with heat meters on the charge and discharge circuits to compute storage efficiency over a cycle.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 蓄熱系統要以「可用溫度以上的熱量」而非總熱量評估性能，並把分層品質列入驗收量測。
knowledge.textEn: Assess a heat store by heat above the useful temperature rather than total heat, and include stratification quality in acceptance measurement.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 62933 電能儲存系統標準系列。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 62933 series on electrical energy storage systems. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「顯熱蓄熱量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sensible heat storage" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 進水擴散器設計不良使冷熱水混合、分層被破壞，雖然總熱量沒有少，可用的高溫熱卻減少，熱泵或鍋爐被迫提早啟動。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
地下蓄熱需要挖一個很大的水槽。
optionsEn: Poor inlet diffusers mix hot and cold water and destroy stratification.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Storing heat underground needs a very large tank dug out.
quiz.explanation: 進水擴散器設計不良使冷熱水混合、分層被破壞，雖然總熱量沒有少，可用的高溫熱卻減少，熱泵或鍋爐被迫提早啟動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Poor inlet diffusers mix hot and cold water and destroy stratification; total heat is unchanged but useful high-temperature heat is reduced and the heat pump or boiler starts early. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 顯熱蓄熱量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sensible heat storage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「顯熱蓄熱量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Sensible heat storage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 進水擴散器設計不良使冷熱水混合、分層被破壞，雖然總熱量沒有少，可用的高溫熱卻減少，熱泵或鍋爐被迫提早啟動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「地下含水層季節儲熱」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Poor inlet diffusers mix hot and cold water and destroy stratification; total heat is unchanged but useful high-temperature heat is reduced and the heat pump or boiler starts early. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Aquifer Seasonal Thermal Energy Storage”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：大型蓄熱體的表面積對體積比小，熱損比例低，甚至可以把夏天的太陽熱存到冬天使用，稱為季節性蓄熱。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A large store has a small surface-to-volume ratio and low relative loss, and can even carry summer solar heat into winter as seasonal storage.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「蓄熱槽裡的熱量只看總量，溫度分布不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Only the total heat in a storage tank matters, not its temperature distribution." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 進水擴散器設計不良使冷熱水混合、分層被破壞，雖然總熱量沒有少，可用的高溫熱卻減少，熱泵或鍋爐被迫提早啟動。
knowledge.textEn: Poor inlet diffusers mix hot and cold water and destroy stratification; total heat is unchanged but useful high-temperature heat is reduced and the heat pump or boiler starts early.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.text: 1960：上海開始以回灌冷水的方式控制地層下陷並供冷
knowledge.textEn: 1960: Shanghai began recharging cold water to control subsidence and provide cooling

quiz.question: 關於「含水層的儲熱密度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Storage density of an aquifer" is correct?
options: 地下蓄熱需要挖一個很大的水槽。
井打在哪裡都可以，只要有水就行。
含水層不是一個地下湖，而是孔隙裡充滿水的砂層——砂粒占了六七成的體積，水占三四成。
optionsEn: Storing heat underground needs a very large tank dug out.
Wells can go anywhere so long as there is water.
An aquifer is not an underground lake but sand with water in its pores, grains taking six or seven tenths of the volume and water three or four.

quiz.explanationEn: An aquifer is not an underground lake but sand with water in its pores, grains taking six or seven tenths of the volume and water three or four. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 含水層的儲熱密度：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Storage density of an aquifer: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「含水層的儲熱密度」如何決定「地下含水層季節儲熱」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Storage density of an aquifer” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Aquifer Seasonal Thermal Energy Storage”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 含水層不是一個地下湖，而是孔隙裡充滿水的砂層——砂粒占了六七成的體積，水占三四成。注入溫水時，被加熱的不只是水，還有砂粒。每立方公尺的飽水砂層升高一度所儲存的熱，大約是純水的三分之二。乘以冷熱井之間的溫差，每立方公尺只能存六度電上下的熱——密度很低。但含水層不必建造，它本來就在那裡，而且體積大到幾乎沒有上限；一口井周圍幾十公尺範圍內的砂層，就是幾十萬立方公尺的蓄熱體。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An aquifer is not an underground lake but sand with water in its pores, grains taking six or seven tenths of the volume and water three or four. Warm water injected heats not only water but grains too. Heat stored per cubic metre of saturated sand per degree is about two thirds that of pure water. Times the difference between warm and cold wells, each cubic metre holds only about six units of heat, a low density. But an aquifer need not be built; it is already there and almost unlimited in volume, sand within tens of metres of one well being hundreds of thousands of cubic metres of store. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：冷儲存在約 60 m 深的含水層，熱儲存在約 300 m 深的含水層
steps.observationEn: Project file: Cold is stored in an aquifer about 60 m down and heat in one about 300 m down
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地下蓄熱需要挖一個很大的水槽。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Storing heat underground needs a very large tank dug out." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「含水層的儲熱密度」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: An aquifer is not an underground lake but sand with water in its pores, grains taking six or seven tenths of the volume and water three or four. Warm water injected heats not only water but grains too. Heat stored per cubic metre of saturated sand per degree is about two thirds that of pure water. Times the difference between warm and cold wells, each cubic metre holds only about six units of heat, a low density. But an aquifer need not be built; it is already there and almost unlimited in volume, sand within tens of metres of one well being hundreds of thousands of cubic metres of store.

knowledge.text: 誤解：地下蓄熱需要挖一個很大的水槽。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Storing heat underground needs a very large tank dug out. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 依「含水層的儲熱密度」的模型 e = c_aq·ΔT，含水層體積熱容 2.8 MJ/(m³·K)、冷熱井溫差 8 K 時每立方公尺的儲熱量最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model e = c_aq·ΔT for "Storage density of an aquifer", which value is closest to the heat stored per cubic metre for an aquifer heat capacity of 2.8 MJ/(m³·K) and 8 K between warm and cold wells?
options: 6.2 kWh/m³
62.2 kWh/m³
3.11 kWh/m³
optionsEn: 6.2 kWh/m³
62.2 kWh/m³
3.11 kWh/m³
quiz.explanation: e = c_aq·ΔT；代入 c = 2.8 MJ/(m³·K)、dT = 8 K，得 6.2 kWh/m³（含水層體積熱容 2.8 MJ/(m³·K)、冷熱井溫差 8 K 時每立方公尺的儲熱量）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: e = c_aq·ΔT; with c = 2.8 MJ/(m³·K), dT = 8 K the result is 6.2 kWh/m³ (heat stored per cubic metre for an aquifer heat capacity of 2.8 MJ/(m³·K) and 8 K between warm and cold wells). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 含水層的儲熱密度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Storage density of an aquifer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「含水層的儲熱密度」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Storage density of an aquifer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：e = c_aq·ΔT；代入 c = 2.8 MJ/(m³·K)、dT = 8 K，得 6.2 kWh/m³（含水層體積熱容 2.8 MJ/(m³·K)、冷熱井溫差 8 K 時每立方公尺的儲熱量）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 dT 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: e = c_aq·ΔT; with c = 2.8 MJ/(m³·K), dT = 8 K the result is 6.2 kWh/m³ (heat stored per cubic metre for an aquifer heat capacity of 2.8 MJ/(m³·K) and 8 K between warm and cold wells). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise dT by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：dT 增加 10% 時，結果變為 6.8 kWh/m³（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising dT by 10% changes the result to 6.8 kWh/m³ (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 6.2 kWh/m³（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 dT 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 6.2 kWh/m³ (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in dT with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: e = c_aq·ΔT；代入 c = 2.8 MJ/(m³·K)、dT = 8 K，得 6.2 kWh/m³（含水層體積熱容 2.8 MJ/(m³·K)、冷熱井溫差 8 K 時每立方公尺的儲熱量）。
knowledge.textEn: e = c_aq·ΔT; with c = 2.8 MJ/(m³·K), dT = 8 K the result is 6.2 kWh/m³ (heat stored per cubic metre for an aquifer heat capacity of 2.8 MJ/(m³·K) and 8 K between warm and cold wells).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: dT 增加 10% 時，結果變為 6.8 kWh/m³（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising dT by 10% changes the result to 6.8 kWh/m³ (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「含水層的儲熱密度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Storage density of an aquifer"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以試驗井的岩心與抽水試驗取得含水層的孔隙率、厚度與透水係數，計算可用的蓄熱體積。
夏天要有冷氣，一定要開冷凍機。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Cores and pumping tests at a trial well give porosity, thickness and permeability of the aquifer for usable storage volume.
Cooling in summer always needs a chiller running.
quiz.explanation: 以試驗井的岩心與抽水試驗取得含水層的孔隙率、厚度與透水係數，計算可用的蓄熱體積。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cores and pumping tests at a trial well give porosity, thickness and permeability of the aquifer for usable storage volume. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 含水層的儲熱密度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Storage density of an aquifer: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「含水層的儲熱密度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Storage density of an aquifer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以試驗井的岩心與抽水試驗取得含水層的孔隙率、厚度與透水係數，計算可用的蓄熱體積。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cores and pumping tests at a trial well give porosity, thickness and permeability of the aquifer for usable storage volume. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：場址調查要以鑽探與抽水試驗確認含水層的幾何與水力特性，再決定儲存的規模與井的配置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Confirm geometry and hydraulic properties of the aquifer by drilling and pumping tests in site investigation, then decide scale of storage and well layout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：含水層太薄或被黏土層分隔成好幾層時，注入的水沿著最透水的那一層快速擴散，蓄熱體的形狀不如預期。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Where the aquifer is thin or split by clay layers, injected water spreads fast along the most permeable layer and the store is not the shape expected. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以試驗井的岩心與抽水試驗取得含水層的孔隙率、厚度與透水係數，計算可用的蓄熱體積。
knowledge.textEn: Cores and pumping tests at a trial well give porosity, thickness and permeability of the aquifer for usable storage volume.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 場址調查要以鑽探與抽水試驗確認含水層的幾何與水力特性，再決定儲存的規模與井的配置。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm geometry and hydraulic properties of the aquifer by drilling and pumping tests in site investigation, then decide scale of storage and well layout.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：ASME PTC 53 機械與熱能儲存系統性能試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: ASME PTC 53 Mechanical and Thermal Energy Storage Systems. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「含水層的儲熱密度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Storage density of an aquifer" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
井打在哪裡都可以，只要有水就行。
含水層太薄或被黏土層分隔成好幾層時，注入的水沿著最透水的那一層快速擴散，蓄熱體的形狀不如預期。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
Wells can go anywhere so long as there is water.
Where the aquifer is thin or split by clay layers, injected water spreads fast along the most permeable layer and the store is not the shape expected.
quiz.explanation: 含水層太薄或被黏土層分隔成好幾層時，注入的水沿著最透水的那一層快速擴散，蓄熱體的形狀不如預期。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Where the aquifer is thin or split by clay layers, injected water spreads fast along the most permeable layer and the store is not the shape expected. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 含水層的儲熱密度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Storage density of an aquifer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「含水層的儲熱密度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Storage density of an aquifer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 含水層太薄或被黏土層分隔成好幾層時，注入的水沿著最透水的那一層快速擴散，蓄熱體的形狀不如預期。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「地下含水層季節儲熱」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Where the aquifer is thin or split by clay layers, injected water spreads fast along the most permeable layer and the store is not the shape expected. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Aquifer Seasonal Thermal Energy Storage”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：但含水層不必建造，它本來就在那裡，而且體積大到幾乎沒有上限；一口井周圍幾十公尺範圍內的砂層，就是幾十萬立方公尺的蓄熱體。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: But an aquifer need not be built; it is already there and almost unlimited in volume, sand within tens of metres of one well being hundreds of thousands of cubic metres of store.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地下蓄熱需要挖一個很大的水槽。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Storing heat underground needs a very large tank dug out." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 含水層太薄或被黏土層分隔成好幾層時，注入的水沿著最透水的那一層快速擴散，蓄熱體的形狀不如預期。
knowledge.textEn: Where the aquifer is thin or split by clay layers, injected water spreads fast along the most permeable layer and the store is not the shape expected.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
